content: Hi @Miguel Ojeda Tyr could definitely start using these zerocopy traits, if we could get them into the bindings. Since this series https://lore.kernel.org/rust-for-linux/20261020-b4-gpu_info_intobytes-v5-1-3e0c7c93223c@collabora.com/ mostly touches the rust/Makefile should it go through rust-next ? If it went in 7.5 then we could probably wait until 7.6 to use it in Tyr @Alice Ryhl
We can also land it and give you a tag if you want to depend on it on the same cycle, i.e. 7.5

@Miguel Ojeda thank you for your Ack on the zerocopy series. @Alice Ryhl I guess this can go through drm-rust-next please. I rebased and it still applies cleanly.

Then the dev_query fixes could be applied directly on top of the zerocopy series:
https://lore.kernel.org/rust-for-linux/20261020-b4-dev_query_fixes-v4-0-df66b4c98bc6@collabora.com/

Building, as for all of drm-rust-next, still needs this unrelated fix: 57d916a3eb76 rust: bindings: derive Zeroable for bindgen's opaque array wrappers
